title: The worklist is a Maintenance reminders tab under Customers
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor (view customers; edit customers to raise a work order), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open the Customers page (do not switch tabs yet).
custom_steps:
1. Find the "Maintenance reminders" tab under Customers and open it.
  2. Type a term in the search on the Customers tab, switch to Maintenance reminders, and check the term.
  3. Look for a "New customer" action on this tab.
  4. Look for a count badge on the Customers nav item and on the Maintenance reminders tab.
  5. Click a row body (not a button or the menu) and see whether anything opens.
  6. Page and sort the list and note whether pages/sorts come from the server.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The list sits under Customers as a "Maintenance reminders" tab and is organization-wide, not location-specific.
  • The Customers search is shared by both tabs (a term typed on one stays when switching); "New customer" belongs to the Customers tab and does not appear here.
  • There is no count badge on the Customers nav item, nor on the Maintenance reminders tab.
  • Rows open nothing - the row's buttons and its three-dot menu are the only way into anything; the list is server-side paged and sorted.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10570 (S13, The worklist); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S13; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R1: “The list will sit under Customers as a Maintenance reminders tab. It is organization wide, not location specific”
  • S13-R32: “The Customers page's search is shared by both tabs: a term typed on one stays when switching to the other. The New customer action belongs to the Customers tab and does not appear here”
  • S13-N1: “There is no count badge on the Customers nav item, nor on the Maintenance reminders tab”
  • S13-R35: “Rows open nothing. The row's buttons and its three-dot menu are the only way into anything from the list”
  • S13-R11: “The list will be server side paged and sorted”
